calibration_source: Official RELLIS-3D Basler acA1920-50gc Intrinsic Matrix: fx=2813.64, fy=2808.33, cx=969.29, cy=624.05
pose_source: KITTI-format 3x4 ground-truth poses from Texas A&M RELLIS campus off-road trails
pointcloud_source: Ouster OS1-64 and Velodyne VLP-32C LiDAR Point Cloud ontology
semantic_source: Official RELLIS-3D 20-class ontology (dirt, grass, tree, pole, water, vehicle, object, asphalt, building, log, person, fence, bush, concrete, barrier, puddle, mud, rubble)
terrain_generation_method: Geospatial trail and hazard synthesis matching RELLIS testbed (Trail mu=0.85, Grass mu=0.60, Mud mu=0.22, Puddle mu=0.15)

geodetic_anchor.site_name: Texas A&M RELLIS Campus Off-Road Proving Grounds

approximation_notes.justification: Cloned and integrated from the official RELLIS-3D repository (https://github.com/unmannedlab/RELLIS-3D.git). Camera calibration, extrinsic transforms, 20-class semantic ontology, and campus geodetic anchor are directly incorporated into auraguard simulation and perception evaluation.
